record_text:
Key points.
Smoke alarms. Alarms on every level, inside and outside bedrooms; test monthly.

Procedure.
Install: place alarms on every level and in each bedroom area. Test monthly: press the test button. Replace: swap batteries yearly and the whole unit every ten years. Never disable: a chirping alarm needs a battery, not removal.
